q: A Sr. DPO sanctions Rs 2 lakh for renovation of his office without any estimate of cost or assessment of need. Which canon of financial propriety is violated?

options.A: No authority should pass an order of expenditure to its own advantage

options.C: Allowances should not be a source of profit to the recipient
options.D: Public money should not benefit a particular person unless the claim is enforceable in a court of law
